findings.evidence: Default when purpose and power are clear but evidence is thin: draft one opener with bracketed placeholders and ask for the one missing fact.
findings.fix: Keep the one-fact rule; move the worked placeholder sentence into references/feedback-sbi-model.md next to the disputed-evidence example, and record the move. The thin-versus-missing test stays in SKILL.md.

findings.evidence: SKILL.md is a 107-line process (classify, route, deliver, receive, reset, follow up) for a navigation task whose detail already lives in five gated references.
findings.fix: Keep the six-step order and R1-R6. Do not add phases; the navigation pattern already fits.

findings.evidence: When power is unequal, state a required change as required. "Could you maybe try..." from a manager makes a non-optional expectation sound optional.
findings.fix: Add one line that the same hedge is correct when the user is not the person who may set the expectation (peer or upward), so the gotcha is not applied in every direction.

findings.evidence: "expected_output": "A constructive preparation and delivery response using SBI, neutral phrasing, curiosity about causes, and an actionable next step."
findings.fix: Rewrite expected_output for casual-code-review, scope-deadline-options and receiving-hostile-feedback to name the pass condition the way notes-to-public-post does (private delivery, one or two dated items, no inferred motive), so a grader can fail a draft that meets the tone but misses the rule.
